name: meta-creative-refresh
description: Detect Meta (Facebook/Instagram) creative fatigue, audit the attributes of winning ads, and generate a production-ready creative brief — hooks, formats (Reels/Stories/feed video/static/carousel), aspect ratios, lengths, CTAs, and messaging angles. Use when the user says "Meta creative refresh", "new Facebook/Instagram ads", "Meta ad fatigue", "Meta creative brief", "what hooks should we test on Meta", "I need fresh Meta creative", or wants a net-new Meta creative brief. Run meta-creative-fatigue-watchdog first to confirm refresh is actually needed.
